messages:
sam (acct-owner): Hey team — saw a surprise on our Feb invoice. We have a bunch of streaming calls where the client cancels mid-gen and dashboard shows ~1.2k tokens but invoice charged ~8.7k for the same session. Request id: r-0b3f2c4a. Model: vicuna-13b. Any ideas?

liz (Support): Sorry about that, Sam. Can you paste the session/log snippet you have? Also which org/account id?

sam (acct-owner): Org: acme-ux. Here's the SSE capture (trimmed):
```
event: chunk
data: {"tokens": 432, "seq": 1}

event: chunk
data: {"tokens": 678, "seq": 2}

event: abort
data: {"reason":"client_cancel","time":1670000000}
```
Dashboard shows sum(tokens)=1110. Invoice shows 8710.

liz (Support): OK. Can you confirm whether the client reconnected or retried the same request id after abort? Also any server-side reconnect logs?

sam (acct-owner): Client did a quick reconnect due to our client lib retry-on-network-flip. It retried the same logical prompt but with a new request id: r-0b3f2c4a-retry. I can reproduce locally if needed.

jon (Eng Recon): tagging in. This smell sounds like a finalization/race where the original stream's "trailer" or finalize event gets applied after a ledger write from the retry — could double-finalize the session. Can I get the full event trace (server logs) for r-0b3f2c4a and r-0b3f2c4a-retry?

maria (Billing): We see an invoice delta of +7600 tokens tied to that timeframe for acme-ux. Happy to credit if it's our fault but need confirm and ledger ids.

sam (acct-owner): Pasting full client trace and headers (sanitized):
```
[stream open] id=r-0b3f2c4a, ts=1670000000
[chunk] seq=1 tokens=432
[chunk] seq=2 tokens=678
[client abort] ts=1670000003 cause=user_cancel
[retry open] id=r-0b3f2c4a-retry, ts=1670000005
[chunk] seq=1 tokens=1200
[finalize] id=r-0b3f2c4a, tokens_final=7600, ts=1670000006
[finalize] id=r-0b3f2c4a-retry, tokens_final=1200, ts=1670000008
```
Not sure why there's a finalize for the original after abort.

liz (Support): Thanks. Jon — can you check whether the reconcile job might have seen the orphaned finalize and applied it? Also any recent deploys that touched stream finalize logic? @deploy-bot any infra deploys in that window?

deploy-bot: deploy completed by ci-pipeline at 2026-02-02T10:05:12Z — stack: stream-finalize-fix (no-op), id d-778f

jon (Eng Recon): I pulled the logs. There's a race: the streaming runtime queues a finalization callback when a KV-cache flush completes. If client aborts very close to that moment and then retries, we currently don't properly idempotent-guard finalizes for old session ids. The retry created a separate ledger entry instead of reusing the original, so both finalize events ended up credited.

jon (Eng Recon): Repro steps I ran: 1) start SSE stream; 2) emit two chunks; 3) client abort; 4) immediate retry with new request id — ledger shows both finalizes recorded. I have a short repro script if you want to run.

liz (Support): Maria — looks like root cause in serving runtime; we'll need to credit acme-ux for the duplicate finalize. Can you advise on typical credit flow and amount?

maria (Billing): If we confirm duplicate finalization we can issue a credit equal to the duplicate tokens (7600). We need the ledger ids: ledger_write_10023 and ledger_write_10024 look linked to those requests in our DB. Sam — can you confirm you want a credit on next invoice or immediate refund?

sam (acct-owner): Next invoice credit is fine. Thanks for the quick triage. Appreciate a short writeup so we can tighten client retry windows on our side too.

jon (Eng Recon): Will open an internal bug and patch to add an idempotency guard on finalize callbacks keyed by session root id + finalize nonce. I'll also run a one-off reconciliation job to mark ledger_write_10023 as duplicated and flag for credit approval.

liz (Support): Ticket created: SUP-2026-4438. Assigned to jon. Action items: jon to run recon job + PR for idempotent finalize; maria to issue credit for ledger_write_10023 duplication; liz to confirm resolution with Sam.

maria (Billing): Credit queued: credit-req-ACME-4438 amount=7600 tokens (applied to next invoice).

jon (Eng Recon): Patch in review: https://git.internal/redwood/stream-runtime/pull/582 — adds guard and adds extra logging when finalize arrives after abort. I'll post once the recon job finishes.

jon (Eng Recon): Recon job done — confirmed duplicate finalize and adjusted reconciliation state. Ledger shows only the retry finalize as authoritative now.

liz (Support): Sam — can you confirm the dashboard token counts now match expected for that session?

sam (acct-owner): Checked — dashboard shows 1200 and invoice credit reflected. All good here. Thanks everyone :tada:

liz (Support): Great. Closing SUP-2026-4438 after verification. Notes: root cause race in streaming finalize; mitigation: server idempotency guard + more conservative client retry guidance.

sam (acct-owner): Appreciate it.

liz (Support): Marking resolved. :thumbsup:
